payload.description_html: Spinosaurid cervicodorsal vertebrae. A Partial mid cervical of Spinosaurus aegyptiacus (FSAC-KK 11888, cast) lacking the anterior end of the centrum, upper portion of the neural spine and postzygapophyses, B Articulated cervicodorsal series C2-D4) of Suchomimus tenerensis (MNBH GAD70) in left lateral view with most of the cervical ribs removed. Scale bar equals 5 cm in A (bottom), 10 cm in A (top) and B. Abbreviations: ns neural spine pl pleurocoel plf platform prz prezygapophysis tp transverse process.
